[[Mantid Hatchling]] is the first mantid encountered in the starting area for new Factions [[roleplaying character]]s. It will remain stationary and not attack. It is a very weak foe, even for level 1 characters. Slightly stronger [[Mantid Drone Hatchling]]s will soon follow once this mantid is defeated.
